description: This PHP source file defines a final class 'MimeType' within the GuzzleHttp\Psr7 namespace. The class provides static methods to determine the MIME type of a file based on its filename or file extension. It includes a method to infer MIME type from filename by extracting the extension, and another method that maps known file extensions to MIME types via a static array.

classes.name: MimeType
classes.description: Provides static utility methods for determining MIME types based on file extensions and filenames.

methods.name: fromFilename
methods.description: Determines the mimetype of a file by looking at its extension, extracting the extension from filename and delegating to fromExtension().

methods.name: fromExtension
methods.description: Maps a file extension to a MIME type using a static lookup table.
